type: AUDIT — not a screen. No effect is measured and none is claimed. Every predictive number below is ILLUSTRATIVE and labelled so.
thesis_under_audit: Analysts predict games well using data and judgment. If we are not predicting as well, find what data they have that we do not, or improve how we use it.
headline: The program's research lane has never once read a same-day information source, and the production lane reads three of them daily. Everything this program knows about its own skill was measured on an information set strictly poorer than the one its own forecaster is handed at run time.

Q1_captured_but_unused.method: Enumerated every directory under data/ in BOTH the worktree and the main repository, profiled each on bytes, then established consumption by path-grep against features/, all 63 E0_*/E1_* exploration screens, the OOF runners and daily_forecast.py. Every grep hit was opened and read before being counted as a read (D086).

named in a docstring explaining why they are NOT used (manifest_present:false / UNVERIFIABLE)

highest_value_find.what_it_is: a closing-ish player POINTS prop line, one snapshot per event, taken a median 1.16 hours before tip
highest_value_find.provenance: snapshot_returned_utc strictly precedes commence_time on 100% of rows; median lead 1.16 h, min 0.57 h, max 3.24 h

illustrative_only_market_quality.caveat: ILLUSTRATIVE. Descriptive of the market line itself. Not a result about any model in this program.

highest_value_find.why_the_program_missed_it: E1_I0013's env audit DID see the 11,237 rows dated 2024 and ruled 'PLAYER PROPS, not game totals; covers only the tail of one of four exploration seasons and extends into the forbidden holdout'. That verdict is correct for a game-tempo question. Under D137 the object of study is the player, so 'player props' is the point rather than a disqualification, and spanning the holdout is the property that makes it a cross-partition yardstick.
highest_value_find.not_a_resurrection: Same file, different question. CLOSED_SURFACES §7's 'market comparison impossible' is about GAME TOTALS and remains correct as stated.

root_cause_of_the_blindness.finding: The data/ directory inside the worktree the exploration screens run in is missing six directories that exist in the main repository, all of them named in .gitignore.
root_cause_of_the_blindness.consequence: At least one recorded impossibility ('market comparison on the exploration partition') has a scope narrower than the record states: it is true of that worktree, not of the repository.
root_cause_of_the_blindness.fix_cost: hours — repoint the screens' DATA root, or un-ignore the capture directories

when_designations_land.source: data/injury_capture/injury_log.csv joined to real per-team tip from odds capture commence_time; 98.0% matched; restricted to captures strictly before tip

the_gap.statement: The program's features are as-of a median 72 hours before tip. The designation that decides availability lands a median 1.0 hour before tip, and every observed change landed inside 3 hours, median 30 minutes.

coverage_and_reliability_of_the_feed.caveat: COVERAGE STATISTIC, NOT A PREDICTIVE RESULT. Close to definitional — the league enforces the designation — and the sample is 9 game days.
coverage_and_reliability_of_the_feed.interpretation: The official report handles the injury channel of unavailability essentially completely and the coach's-decision channel not at all.

Q3_forward_validation.what_would_fix_it: The T-1.16h player-points line spans the partition and barely moves across it (corr 0.5439 / 0.5380 / 0.5765; MAE 4.929 / 4.977 / 4.923 on 2024 / 2025 / 2026). A model scored against it on both sides is compared to the same opponent under the same conditions, which makes an E2 replication interpretable.
